title: Rava bar Tachlifa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eruvin 40a in Ravina’s time. Hyman calls this a scribal error, for Rava bar Tachlifa was one of Rav’s students. He says that undoubtedly it was written רב״א, that is Rav Acha bar Tachlifa, and so it is in Dikdukei Soferim.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Eruvin 40a passage names Rava bar Tachlifa addressing Ravina. Hyman’s declaration of a scribal error, his ‘undoubtedly’ expansion to Rav Acha bar Tachlifa, his teacher claim, and his Dikdukei Soferim report remain attributed arguments. The apparatus and the proposed historical identification have not been independently established here.
